verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no versioning, review, or rollback of automation definitions such as jobs, schedules, or deployed agents. Sandbox snapshots and rollback (docs-21) restore sandbox runtime state, which is an adjacent feature. Per-run execution history on schedules (docs-26) is run logging, not version review. Config in blaxel.toml or a GitHub Action CI pipeline (docs-13) would only let users version automations through their own git workflow, which is a user-side workaround.
